summary.en: A famous movie Yuki-onna star and her body double show up at the same cabin Kogoro and family are spending vacation time at Yamagata Prefecture, but when a note and a mysterious illness seem to overcome the star, then Kogoro decides to begin searching it as a case. Is there something more than a mysterious suicide note though that could indicate murder? Victim: Akiko Kinoshita Cause of death: Hypothermia (low body temperature) Suspects: Yoko Asanuma
